CVE-2026-53489 (GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388, GO-2026-5622): when containerd's CRI plugin restored a container from a checkpoint image, it restored container.log without checking for a symbolic link, so the restored container's log could expose an arbitrary host file through kubectl logs. Debian marks containerd not affected in bullseye, bookworm (1.6.20) and trixie (1.7.24) because the vulnerable code exists only in 2.x, and lists forky and sid fixed in 2.1.9+ds1-1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-53489). The Docker Scout CLI is a containerd client and does not contain containerd's CRI plugin. Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-28: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each installs one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with GOOS=linux and CGO_ENABLED=0. It has the same Go release and module versions as the scout-cli program of the same version and architecture, built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath. Its Go build information, read from every published Alpine 3.23 package, shows github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 v2.2.1 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.20.4-r4, v2.2.4 in 1.21.0-r0 to 1.21.0-r2, v2.2.5 in 1.23.1-r0 to 1.23.1-r4, v2.3.2 in 1.23.1-r5 to 1.23.1-r8, v2.3.5 in 1.23.1-r9, v2.4.1 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.30.0-r0 and v2.4.2 in 1.30.0-r1, with no replace directive for that module in any build. Only 1.20.4-r1 to 1.21.0-r2 carry a release in the affected ranges (v2.2.1 and v2.2.4). We downloaded and unpacked all 28 Alpine 3.23 scout-cli and scout-cli-dev packages of 1.20.4-r1 to 1.20.4-r4 and 1.21.0-r0 to 1.21.0-r2 on both architectures (14 of them scout-cli-dev packages), each with a checksum equal to the index: in every one go tool nm lists no function of github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/internal/cri (no criService.CRImportCheckpoint), and a search of the whole binary finds no occurrence of that package path or of the bare name CRImportCheckpoint (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions), while the same searches find 321 functions of github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/client (text symbols in go tool nm, counting the compiler-generated equality functions for its types) and runtime.main in every one. Go records each compiled source file in the binary's file table as <module>@<version>/<directory>/<file>.go (under /go/pkg/mod/ in the -dev builds, which are built without -trimpath): in every one it names no file under github.com/containerd/containerd/v2@<version>/internal/cri/, no container_checkpoint_linux.go and no path containing /internal/cri/ at all, while it names 19 files under github.com/containerd/containerd/v2@<version>/client/. No published build contains the vulnerable code: the builds 1.20.4-r1 to 1.21.0-r2 do not contain it, and 1.23.1-r0 and later carry a fixed release.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-53489 (GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388, GO-2026-5622): when containerd's CRI plugin restores a container from a checkpoint archive, it followed a symbolic link placed at the container log path inside the archive, so a crafted checkpoint could read a host file into the container's log. OSV lists github.com/containerd/containerd/v2 2.1.0 to before 2.1.9, 2.2.0 to before 2.2.5 and 2.3.0 to before 2.3.2, with criService.CRImportCheckpoint, CreateContainer and StartContainer in github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/internal/cri/server as the vulnerable functions (https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5622, https://github.com/containerd/containerd/security/advisories/GHSA-rgh6-rfwx-v388). The advisory cites https://github.com/containerd/containerd/commit/8196411f24065533093be4c7ad874c23b06178f3 ('cri: make checkpoint restore robust to unexpected archive content'), and the containerd v2.2.5 release notes list this CVE (https://github.com/containerd/containerd/releases/tag/v2.2.5). The scout-cli-fips-dev packages are the FIPS builds of the same Docker Scout CLI source, with Go's FIPS 140-3 mode turned on, and are published in the DHI security repository, not in the repository we read for the other owners. Pending: a per-build reading of the Go build information (containerd/v2 module version) and function names (whether github.com/containerd/containerd/v2/internal/cri is linked) of every published scout-cli-fips-dev build for Alpine 3.23 on both architectures; until that reading is done this owner stays under investigation.
